sources.title: GitHub - zinahghul/ehr-timeline-forecast
sources.snippet: A leak-free machine learning pipeline that converts longitudinal EHR data into tokenized patient timelines, pretrains a causal Transformer with next-event prediction, and fine-tunes it to predict conditions newly diagnosed within 5 years after an anchor date.

sources.title: Zero-shot Medical Event Prediction Using a Generative Pre-trained ...
sources.snippet: In this work, we developed a GPT model for forecast-ing EHR concepts using a zero-shot learning approach. This approach ofers benefits for healthcare systems by eliminating the need for task-specific fine-tuning, the scaling of which is limited by computational costs, cohort labeling challenges, and ongoing model maintenance.
